basic_info.description: GREAT NEW PRICE! Perfect for 1st-time homebuyers or as a pied-a-terre, this newer-construction 1BD condo is located in the trendy Valencia St corridor with its plethora of popular restaurants, boutique shops and bustling nightlife surrounded by Hayes Valley, Mission District and Castro neighborhoods. Dolores Park is just a few blocks away. Centrally located, the home is a commuter's dream with the 16th & Mission BART nearby, easy freeway access plus tech and UCSF shuttle stops nearby. When not out and about in this dynamic atmosphere, you'll love being at home in unit #405 with its oversized windows that bathe the home in natural light and boast City views looking east. Built in 2012, the stylish building welcomes your guests with an elegant glass lobby. Excellent common-area amenities including an enclosed courtyard and expansive roof deck with stunning 360 degree City views + a lounge area and built-in barbecue. The home itself checks off numerous features such as hardwood floors, Caesarstone counters, stainless appliances and newer fridge, updated BA w/walk-in shower, newer in-unit washer/dryer, fresh interior paint + additional storage large enough to store bikes, skies, luggage and more. Leased parking in building garage available. Scores: Walk=99; Bike=100; Transit=100
